title: Cops Make Horrifying Discovery in Makeshift Fire Pit
description:
Bodycam footage shows Texas police stumbling upon a brush fire in the middle of a field. The officers discovered what appeared to be the charred remains of a body burning in a makeshift fire pit. The body was burned beyond recognition, smoldering as investigators collected evidence as lightning and thunder roared on that tragic night. A dog was found at the crime scene and after repeated attempts to shoo the animal away, officers realized the furry companion might be connected to the victim. Find out what happened next on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
